description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat.

uses.name: Kami of Whispered Hopes
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater
